question.html:
An aerial acrobat of mass kg is attached to an elastic vertical fabric and performs a drop vertically downwards. At a certain height, the fabric begins to stretch and as a result, the aerial acrobat starts slowing down. The maximum extension of the fabric during the drop is cm. The elastic constant of the fabric is N kg.

a. Calculate the momentum of the aerial acrobat at the instant when the fabric begins to stretch.

   [2]

After finishing her training the aerial acrobat jumps into a soft crash mat from a height of m and comes to rest in ms. Air resistance is negligible.

b. Calculate the magnitude of the average decelerating force that is exerted by the crash mat on the aerial acrobat. 

   [4]

c. Explain why the aerial acrobat prefers to land on the soft crash mat and not on a hard concrete floor
